# dreamrouter_static_routes (Data Source)

Lists the router's static routes, including those made in the web UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_static_routes" "all" {}

output "routes" {
  value = { for r in data.dreamrouter_static_routes.all.routes : r.network => r.next_hop if r.enabled }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `routes` (Attributes List) The static routes, sorted by network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `distance` (Number) Administrative distance.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is active.
- `id` (String) The route's ID.
- `name` (String) The route's name.
- `network` (String) Destination network, e.g. "192.168.2.0/24".
- `next_hop` (String) Address the traffic goes to.
